description: AGSC-03-19 and AGSC-03-20: foreign link names are mapped on import and never added to the vocabulary — refines becomes narrower, conflicts-with becomes excludes, blockedBy becomes blocked-by and tests becomes verifies. Derivation over one OKF document with those four keys: the mapped frontmatter carries the four Link keys with the same targets, none of the four foreign spellings survives, and each mapping is reported once as the AGSC-E506 warning of AGSC-01-22 (a foreign construct carried across with a note), so four such warnings are expected for the links and no error; the document declares a type, a title, prov and an established licence (CC0-1.0), so the licence record of AGSC-01-22 (status: draft and a further AGSC-E506) is not in play, no other AGSC-E506 is raised, and the case isolates the mapping by its input alone. Supersedes imp-0003, whose input declared no licence and was isolated by the runner instead.
note: added 2026-09-25 at rc.6 as the successor of imp-0003; expected values derived by hand from the rule text, not from a run of any engine
